profile.headline: System Analyst Web Developer at Argonne National Laboratory
profile.summary: Diverse, resourceful IT professional with demonstrated experience in full Agile System Development Life-Cycle (SLDC).  Proven abilities and subject matter expertise leading complex technology initiatives to develop business applications and innovative, system-driven solutions designed to address dynamic and challenging business requirements.  Superior technical knowledge of contemporary programming tools and techniques complemented by exceptional skills in utilizing and integrating emerging technologies towards the achievement of specific organizational goals and objectives.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer - Consultant
positions.description:
Project Highlights:
• Design and develop Gentran EDI system and related workflow to optimize the purchase order, invoicing, shipping processes, while enabling real-time data integration to a Just-In-Time order management system.
• Collaborate with the organizational development team to design and develop a Procurement and Receiving system using PowerBuilder and Oracle database solutions compliant with US Government and Department of Energy (DOE) rules and regulations.  This system is 100% paperless and rated one of the premier procurement systems among all national research laboratories and conform to DOE auditing mandates.
• Developed a GUI-based routing system that automated the purchase requisition approval process significantly reducing the cycle time from 14 days to 2 days 
• Responsible for comprehensive Oracle database management and development of stored procedures, triggers, packages, and functions designed to optimize the efficiency and effectiveness of data storage across the entire Argonne enterprise.
• Meet with business users for requirement studies in order to develop solutions to address their unique needs.
• Design and develop interfaces for key financial systems and other reporting applications including OLE (with MS Office) to auto-generate purchase orders in accordance with procurement type.
• Key member of project team to convert all printed reports to PDF, thereby enabling appropriate electronic report distribution.
• Provide on-going client support and collaboration with auditors on various DOE, internal and external audits.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project Highlights:
• Perform comprehensive database management and data migration from proprietary HP databases to MS SQL Server.  Converted all paper based policies to PDF, which optimized policy retention and simplified document retrieval and distribution.
• Develop a .NET system designed to electronically receive data files for optimizing the processing and transmission of rejected transactions for timely remediation and correction.
• Develop a process using .NET for electronically countersigning (via stamp image) PDF policies.
• Collaborate with internal, external, and various government auditors on a variety of audits.
• Provide on-going client support to enhance existing systems and incorporate changes for local and state government regulations.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
• Senior Consultant helping with enhancements to Manufacturing Order Management System. 
• Implementing EDI transaction in an out of the Manufacturing Order Management System
• Adding just in time purchasing system for raw materials

positions.title: Senior Technology Consultant
positions.description: Serve as Technical Lead or Senior Developer on assignments for Fortune 500 customers. Clients included: Healthcare, Food, Banking, Insurance, Travel, Manufacturing and Automotive industries
